FINAL REVIEW of PR #731 at exact head 1614571ea36f1ffcbef0d5d7fa471798473b4c97; effective profile rules-clause-complete. Reviewed the whole 29-file origin/main...HEAD diff under the eshyra-ffoo USER DECISION 2026-11-07 OPTION C, eshyra-0dtg decision, eshyra-j9rc, both implementer reports, design-and-pr-review-policy, ADR 0020, importer-fix-protocol and rules-pack-compiler. The local refs/beads/state projection predates these beads and contains none of them; governing scope/status was reconciled against the live bd records requested by the user.

S1 MATERIAL — Ordinary 0-HP swarm links do not close, violating Option C's explicit requirement, "the link closes at 0 HP as for any linked creature." The newly owned noPrintedEnding grant correctly has no invented revertOn or vanish rule, but there is no ordinary-0-HP link closure behind that promise. In state/activeEffects.ts:4275-4288, zeroHp is derived only from printed revertOn and atZeroHitPoints is refused otherwise; validateItemGrantBinding's zeroHpActorIds is consequently empty for Pipes. In state/encounterCombatants.ts:4290-4305 the link-closing aftermath runs only when status becomes absent (vanish/reversion), not when an ordinary swarm reaches 0 HP/dead. The out-of-combat updateCampaignActor path at :336-419 likewise closes links only for vanish/reversion. The ffoo.1 report's assertion that generic linked-actor behavior supplies 0-HP closure is false for this grant.
Evidence: /tmp/eshyra-731-zero-hp.ts (results /tmp/eshyra-731-zero-hp-results.jsonl) uses the unmodified bundled pack and default tool registry, gives/attunes actual Pipes, spends 1 or 2 charges, binds the corresponding live rat swarm actors using the returned credit, then applies update_combatant hpDelta -24. The creatures become hp_current=0/status=dead/zero_hp_rule=NULL, but their active_effect_link rows remain active; after the last creature dies, the effect remains active too. Repeated with one and two creatures, and after close_combat_instance followed by the semantic updateCampaignActor hpCurrent=0/status=dead seam: all four cases retain active links/effects. The multi-actor exploratory probe also showed that the first death does not close its own link. Credits remain redeemed, so this is stale ownership/lifecycle state, not a refund or extra-credit issue. This failure is reachable on the newly green real-pack operation and survives checkpoint/replay like other state.
Required next state: repair ordinary linked-creature 0-HP closure within this PR, including durable campaign actors, without adding an unprinted duration/revertOn or making ordinary dead rats vanish. Close exactly the affected link and finalizeEnd only when no owned creatures remain; preserve the already redeemed credit and the Horn/bonded-summon behavior. Permanent evidence should be a generalized real-pack lifecycle invariant (one/multiple actors, partial/last death, in/out of combat), proportionate to the durable ownership failure. The existing Pipes no-waiver tests exercise explicit end_effect and zero-actor creation, but never damage a nonempty bound swarm to 0 HP, so they do not detect S1.

S2 NON-MATERIAL — Pack/source review found no additional defect. Independently compared both records arrays: only magic-item:pipes-of-the-sewers changes, with no added/deleted records. Checked vendored SRD pp.232-233. The grant retains its actual swarm reference and charges economy, adds maxCountPerCost {economy:charges,perUnit:1} and noPrintedEnding:true, and invents no fixed/rolled count, duration, reversion, attitude or control enforcement. All adjudicated sourceText spans are exact substrings of the unchanged printed description. The removed triage-entityGrant-1 sourceText is preserved verbatim in m4-control-pipes-of-the-sewers; triage-entityGrant-0 still carries the shortest-route/uncontrolled-arrival sentence. Availability/wasted-charge text and rat indifference including the threaten-or-harm exception remain present. The attitude projection's removal is expressly required by Option C/faithful-or-absent, not an unexplained weakening.

S3 NON-MATERIAL — Ownership recomputation found no omission-based expansion. Ran the origin/main and HEAD predicates over both old/new packs. HEAD predicate on the OLD pack gives exactly the old owned set. Owned blocks change from 8 items/16 grant IDs to 9 items/17 IDs, solely adding Pipes/called-rat-swarms. Previously owned and unchanged: Bag of Tricks (gray/rust/tan-bag-creature), Bowl/water-elemental, Brazier/fire-elemental, Censer/air-elemental, Stone/earth-elemental, Elemental Gem (blue-sapphire/yellow-diamond/red-corundum/emerald-elemental), Horn of Valhalla (silver/brass/bronze/iron-berserkers), Ring of Djinni Summoning/particular-djinni. Manual of Golems, Iron Flask, Staff of the Python and all other pending blocks stay pending. Explicit count/bound AND an explicit ending/noPrintedEnding marker are still required; omission does not make the production predicate true. S1 concerns execution of the new ownership commitment, not collateral ownership expansion.

S4 NON-MATERIAL — Schema, credit bounds and persistence found no additional defect. New fields are closed/validated: creature-only, known matching cooldown economy, positive integral perUnit, count/countRoll/creatureRoll exclusivity; noPrintedEnding must be true and excludes duration/revertOn. use_item persists the actual resolved economy spend on each bind credit in the paying transaction. start_effect requires the named credit, validates campaign/instance/pack/variant/economy and unredeemed state, reads spent_amount internally and admits only 0..spent*perUnit. Probed missing/unknown/cross-instance credits, over-cap binds, a second credit with a larger spend than the oldest, atomic refusals, repeat redemption and NULL recorded spend. The cap is not taken from caller input. Horn rolledCounts producer/consumer logic is unchanged and its conformance tests pass. Migration 0056 adds a nullable column with no invented backfill. Generic schema/row serialization and replay include it. /tmp/eshyra-731-state-probe.ts (results /tmp/eshyra-731-state-results.txt) verified new-schema checkpoint/restore equality, replay restoration of spend and redemption state followed by successful rebinding, and a genuine v55-schema checkpoint with existing credits restored/migrated to v56: old credits retain NULL and their bounded binds are refused.

S5 NON-MATERIAL — eshyra-0dtg is implemented as decided. The zero-actor upper-bound bind redeems its credit before finalizeEnd, emits created then ended with source-removed/no-creatures-answered and the required wasted-charge note, returns an ended effect, leaves no active actor links, refuses a second redemption and has clean integrity for that effect. Comparing item state before/after confirms no charge refund or cooldown-anchor rewrite; Pipes records cooldownAnchored:false so finalizeEnd does not invent a grant-ended recharge. Explicit end_effect for a nonempty bind closes its links. The added start_effect/use_item descriptions and deterministic capability inventory accurately describe the new bounded-credit contract and residual DM interpretation; no further model-facing discrepancy was established.

S6 NON-MATERIAL — Existing test changes are authorized contract changes. The old j9rc blocker pin explicitly required replacement once its boundary moved; its successor tests genuinely use the unmodified pack/default registry without readiness waivers and discriminate spend, cap, no-credit/NULL-spend refusals, redemption, zero bind and dawn 1d3 capped at 3. Rat source-exception evidence survives in the ABSENT/adjudicated span assertion. Ownership/readiness allowlists, generated clause counts, backlog fingerprint and migration-ledger updates match the actual authorized diffs. Their missing 0-HP transition evidence is part of S1, not a second finding. Verification in this read-only review: 17 focused Vitest files, 704 tests passed (112 + 573 + 19); verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exact including all sibling artifacts; semi-structured inventory --check current at 1886 rows; git diff --check clean. Vitest used configLoader runner, no cache and /tmp fsModuleCachePath. No format, verify:worktree, build, commit, push, GitHub comment or merge was run. All custom probe files/output were confined to /tmp. Worktree remained clean at the pinned SHA. No other bead was modified or closed.
